decision.comment: HH_260906 - Freeze candidate-aware scoring before new model training or validation outputs are observed.
decision.purpose: Compare shared context-and-trajectory scoring against the frozen C context-only scorer, without modifying loss weights, physical decoding, data, or safety gates.
decision.architecture: E scores normalized detached predicted XY and speed with fused context using one shared MLP. It preserves seeded common initialization but has 1068249 parameters versus C 954590; equal optimizer steps do not imply equal compute or wall-clock time.
decision.candidate_screen: Selected ADE and FDE must improve in all three paired seeds; selected geometry pass count must not fall and speed MAE must not rise more than 5% in any pair.
decision.budget: 1540 optimizer steps on train1147 with batch4 is approximately 5.37 epochs, not 10 epochs. All seeds start fresh; no checkpoint resume or best-validation-epoch selection.
decision.test_policy: Development validation only. Never evaluate or select on held-out Town04 test in this campaign.
decision.promotion: No automatic promotion, runtime-bundle allowlist change, vehicle actuation, safety-gate weakening, or failed-result deletion. Keep the existing live shadow checkpoint unchanged.
